standards.content:
US Passport Standards:
            - MRZ Type: TD3 (2 lines, 44 chars each)
            - MRZ Line 1: P<USA followed by surname<<given names
            - Passport number: 9 alphanumeric characters
            - Fields: Surname, Given Names, Nationality (USA), Date of Birth, Sex, Place of Birth, Issue Date, Expiry Date, Passport Number
            - Valid expiry: 10 years for adults (16+), 5 years for minors
            - Security features: holographic laminate, UV ink, RFID chip (ePassport), laser engraved photo

Indian Passport Standards:
            - MRZ Type: TD3 (2 lines, 44 chars each)
            - MRZ Line 1: P<IND followed by surname<<given names
            - MRZ Line 2: passport number (9 chars) + check digit + IND + DOB (YYMMDD) + check digit + sex + expiry (YYMMDD) + check digit + personal number + check digit + composite check digit
            - Fields: Surname, Given Names, Nationality (IND), Date of Birth, Sex, Place of Birth, Date of Issue, Date of Expiry, Place of Issue
            - Valid expiry: 10 years from issue for adults, 5 years for minors
            - Passport number format: alphanumeric, starts with letter, 8 chars total
            - Security features: UV reactive ink, hologram, microtext, laser perforation

expected_features.content:
Common Document Security Features:
            - UV fluorescent ink: glows under 365nm UV light
            - Microtext: text smaller than 0.2mm, blurs when photocopied
            - Guilloché patterns: complex geometric backgrounds, create Moiré when copied
            - Rainbow printing: smooth color gradient, impossible on CMYK printers
            - Hologram: kinegram that shifts color and pattern when tilted
            - Laser perforation: holes through all pages, conical shape
            - Security threads: metallic strips woven through paper
            - Watermarks: visible when held to light
            - Intaglio printing: raised ink texture, tactile feel
            - RFID chip: biometric data in ePassports (ICAO 9303 Part 9)

Schengen Visa Standards:
            - Visa sticker dimensions: 105mm x 74mm
            - MRZ: 2 lines, 36 chars each (TD1 format)
            - Fields: Valid From, Valid Until, Duration of Stay, Number of Entries, Issued In, On Date, Number, Type, Remarks
            - Entry types: single (01), double (02), multiple (MULT)
            - Holographic kinegram with EU stars
            - Color shifting ink on visa number
            - Microtext on borders
            - Countries: 26 Schengen member states
